comment: nhlua.c nhl_loadlua() through wiz_load_lua() with names that have a directory part: fopen() resolves each against the playground, so './nhlib.lua' and 'save/../quest.lua' run those library files (nhl_init()'s nhlib.lua shuffle, plus nhlib.lua's own), while 'nodir/dungeon.lua', 'oracles/x.lua' (a file used as a directory) and '../nosuch/file' (outside the playground) take the Error opening impossible(). Seed, date and Healer chosen independently.
